scope: public.tcg_cards source=tcgdex-ja data_status=pending in the 42 TCGdex JP series of the 2026-10-14 audit (SM 35, S 7), M6a excluded (already decided). Read-only; no DB write.

population.note: Audit said 377 total minus M6a 35 = 342; the live DB recount is 348 pending cards in these 42 series (330 above the official max number plus 18 whose number is inside the official range). 341 of them carry a number that is absent from the official list for the mark, which matches the audit within 1. M6 098/099 (2 pending SR) are outside this scope: official M6 098 ポケモンキャッチャー and 099 とくちゅうチョッキ exist with the same name and SR.

classes.OFFICIAL_UNDER_OTHER_MARK: same Japanese name + number under another mark or product in the official search
classes.OFFICIAL_OMITS_REAL_CARD: official page or image shows the card exists physically but the official card search does not list it
classes.LIKELY_TCGDEX_ERROR: number, name or rarity contradict the official card at that number
classes.UNRESOLVED: no card-level official evidence either way; the lean field says which way the structural evidence points
classes.OFFICIAL_SAME_MARK_MATCH_ISSUE: NOT one of the 4 requested classes: the official page exists in the same mark and only the name notation or a missing or unparsed number differs (an identity-matching issue, not a missing card)

method.offline: 20,711 cached official detail pages (299 marks) and 134 official lists: same NFKC name across all marks, same mark+number, official max number, contiguous-numbering check
method.online: pokemon-card.com only, 228 requests (226 x 200, 2 x 404): 126 keyword searches over all marks (resultAPI.php, 125 distinct names), 62 card-detail pages (one per series to read the product link, 3 ID probes right after SR blocks, 6 identity checks, the rest re-reads for series whose first read had no product link), 37 product pages (/products and /ex), 2 guessed product URLs that returned 404, 1 news page
method.rate: single connection, at least 1.6 s between requests, stop on two consecutive non-200 (the only two non-200 were 404s from guessed product URLs, which stopped that script as designed)

findings: 348 張在官方卡片搜尋（20,711 筆快取詳細頁、125 次全標記關鍵字查詢）都找不到「同名同號、不同標記」的卡：OFFICIAL_UNDER_OTHER_MARK = 0。
官方商品頁證實 S5 與 S6 有官方搜尋沒有的「スペシャルアート」VMAX：S6H 085、S6K 086 的卡號由官方圖檔名直接寫出，與 TCGdex 完全一致；S5I 的 いちげきウーラオスVMAX SA 版也由官方頁證實。
官方 SM12a 184（メルメタルGX SR）、197（ホミカ SR）與 TCGdex 的 ルカリオ&メルメタルGX UR、ホミカの演奏 UR 名稱與稀有度都抵觸，是唯一確定的 TCGdex 錯誤。
官方資料庫在 S9（2022）之前完全沒有 HR／UR 稀有度圖示，S9 起每個主系列有 9–11 張 HR＋UR；S5I–S8 的 TCGdex 多出 10–14 張，形狀與其一致；官方 2018 年新聞頁也把 HR（ハイパーレア）當正式稀有度。這是官方漏收的結構性證據，不是逐卡證據。
